sentences.text: Perused the representations at Annexures-E and F. Petitioners have sought for disbursal of compensation in terms of the said representations.

5. Sri. H. L. Pradeep Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the KIADB submits that the said representations at Annexures-E and F, would be considered and appropriate orders passed in accordance with law and as per the legal entitlement of petitioners within a period of 3 months from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order.
NC: 2026:KHC:13672 HC-KAR 6.
Recording the undertaking of the learned counsel for the KIADB, petition is disposed of.
All contentions on merits are kept open.

Needless to state, petitioners to make out clarifications and furnish documents as may be required and the respondents are also at liberty to correspond with the revenue department in the event any clarifications are required.
